sources.title: Pella Research — Audio Deepfake Detection
sources.snippet: In August 2026, Podonos published an independent audio deepfake detection benchmark: 4,524 clips across six file formats, synthetic speech from about 25 modern voice cloning systems, scored blind against private labels.
